title: Bias Analysis and Mitigation through Protected Attribute Detection and Regard Classification

bias_targets.methodology: Co-occurrence frequency analysis and regard classification (assessing positive, neutral, or negative language polarity) on pretraining corpora, utilizing keyword matching combined with word sense disambiguation.
Co-occurrence frequency analysis and regard classification on pretraining corpora, further validated by measuring alignment with the SeeGULL stereotype benchmark's offensiveness scores.
